title: feat(spec): the package export manifest declares withheldMaps, classified door for the unmanaged import
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi93WJttNHMw9kPDPtpWDpXEq)_
Fixes #29373

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — an export response key the runtime writes; no metadata author writes it, so no skill or authoring doc teaches it

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：包导出清单（`GET /packages/:id/export` 的契约）新增可选键 `withheldMaps`，逐条列出导出时被整张扣下的连接器请求头 / 环境变量表的位置（只列位置，不列任何头名或变量名）；非托管导入的键分类表把它记为 `door`。导出一直声明的 `label` 在该表里也从未分类，同 PR 一并记为 `door`。
- 为什么改：导出读的是脱敏后的条目，连接器的四张凭据表在导出里直接缺席，导入方分不清"被扣下"还是"本来就没有"。这是 #28640 裁决 ③A 的 spec 半边，server 半边 #29342 等它落地后再写导出和两道安装门。
- 风险与回滚：纯 spec 声明加一行分类，无运行时改动，导出暂不写该键。实测：改动前，带 `label` 或 `withheldMaps` 的导出被非托管导入整包拒收；改动后两者都被接受、新基座清单不带它们。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`（新键与 describe）、`packages/spec/src/kernel/unmanaged-install.ts`（两行 `door` 及注释）、`packages/spec/src/kernel/unmanaged-install.test.ts`（全量性测试改为同时读导出清单的固定键）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts src/kernel/unmanaged-install.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件全部通过，含「refuses a list of the withheld header names」与「classifies every fixed key of the package export」两条新用例。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## New names (proposed; the seat's call)

- `PackageExportManifestSchema.withheldMaps`: a new fixed key on a published contract.
- Its entry's sub-keys: `type` (the literal `connector`), `name`, `path` (closed set: `providerConfig.headers`, `providerConfig.defaultHeaders`, `providerConfig.transport.headers`, `providerConfig.transport.env`).
- No new export: the entry is declared inline, so `api-surface` does not move.
- Alternatives considered: `withheld` (shorter, but reads as a boolean), `incompleteMaps` (names the import's reading rather than the export's act), `redactedMaps` (collides with the redactor's internal `redactedKeys`, which is deliberately never put on the wire).

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`: `PackageExportManifestSchema` gains the optional fixed key `withheldMaps`, an array of strict `{ type: 'connector', name, path }` entries. The docblock now says five fixed keys and explains the key (#28640 ruling ③A). `PackageExportManifestSchema` stays the same exported constant, so the bundle schema in draft #29100 composes it by identity as before.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/unmanaged-install.ts`: `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` gains `withheldMaps: 'door'` and `label: 'door'`. The module note and the table's docblock now name the export's fixed keys as the third schema a package body is read with; the `door` definition says the door may set a key aside (the export's `label`).
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx` (the key and its nested shape), `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (one row: `api/PackageExportManifest:withheldMaps`), `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/api.md` (`api/` sites 487 to 488, the new `.strict()` entry).
- `.changeset/29373-export-withheld-maps.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, with the two declaration lines copied from the claim as the seat amended it (`Metadata-protocol: added`).
- Not touched: runtime. The export does not write the key yet, and the install doors do not read it yet; that is the server half, #29342.

### The path vocabulary, measured

The card spells three of the four maps without their root (`defaultHeaders`, `transport.headers`, `transport.env`). On main the connector redactor's `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIAL_MAP_PATHS` (`packages/spec/src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.ts`) holds all four under `providerConfig`, and `redactConnectorItem` reports them in `redactedKeys` as `providerConfig.headers`, `providerConfig.defaultHeaders`, `providerConfig.transport.headers`, `providerConfig.transport.env`. The closed enum uses that spelling, so the export can copy the redactor's own report. A closed set of four is right for this card: it is exactly the set the redactor withholds whole as maps. The redactor's other positions (undeclared `auth` keys, `authentication` keys, credential URL parts) are single values, not maps, and webhook `headers` is out of scope by the seat ruling. A test holds the enum equal to the redactor's list and to its `redactedKeys` on a real redaction, so the two cannot drift.

### `label`, measured

The card noted (not measured) that the export's top-level `label` is not classified. Measured on this branch's base (`04e0c2c0`): `PackageExportManifestSchema` declares `label`; `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` has no row for it; the import planner's default arm refuses an unclassified key. A probe calling `planUnmanagedImport` with `{ id, name, version, label: 'Example CRM' }`, run against a spec build with the two rows removed, answered `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_UNCOPYABLE` "`label` — not a key a package body declares, so the import cannot place it" (and the same for `withheldMaps`); against this PR's build both are accepted and the base manifest is `{ name, version, id, namespace }`. So it is a real gap, classified here and declared as a deviation. It is `door`, not `identity`: the base is installed through the closed `PackageInstallManifestSchema`, which has no `label`, so carrying it would refuse the base. Reach: the export writes `label` only from `pkg.manifest.label ?? pkg.label`, and no schema in this tree declares either (`ManifestSchema` and `PackageInstallManifestSchema` are closed without `label`), so no declared producer here emits it today; the gap is between two spec contracts.

## Tests

New:
- `package-lifecycle.test.ts`: an export carrying `withheldMaps` parses and is preserved; the key is optional; the path enum equals `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIAL_MAP_PATHS` and the redactor's `redactedKeys`; five refusals (a position outside the four, a position without its `providerConfig` root, a non-connector type, an entry carrying a list of header names, an entry with no name).
- `unmanaged-install.test.ts`: "classifies every fixed key of the package export", and a pin that `withheldMaps` and `label` are `door`.

Forced edits (named):
- `unmanaged-install.test.ts` "classifies nothing neither schema declares": renamed "classifies nothing no schema declares", and its declared set now includes the export's fixed keys. Without this, the new `withheldMaps` row would red it as a stale row.
- `unmanaged-install.test.ts` and `package-lifecycle.test.ts` describe titles: "both schemas" to "the three schemas"; "four fixed keys" to "five fixed keys"; "requires exactly the four fixed keys" to "requires only the three identity keys" (the old title was already loose: `label` was optional).

Reverse check (each table row deleted with `ablation-replace.mjs`, then `unmanaged-install.test.ts`): deleting `withheldMaps: 'door'` reds "classifies every fixed key of the package export" and the door pin; deleting `label: 'door'` reds the same two. Tree restored to HEAD each time (`git diff HEAD` empty).

## Acceptance notes

- `Check Changeset` level axis: the claim first read `Metadata-protocol: none`; the gate refuses it because the regenerated `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` shard moved, and refuses `added` with a `patch` changeset. The seat amended the claim to `added`, matching main's precedent for API response keys (`.changeset/28737-record-page-timeline-count.md`, `28722-customizations-contributions.md`), and the changeset is now `@objectstack/spec: minor` (commit `27e2a7a5`). Measured offline on head `27e2a7a5` with this body: `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event FILE` exits 0 (LEVEL AXIS passes).
- Opened on base `04e0c2c0`, not merged with main: main is 20 commits ahead, none touching these 8 files or the `api` shards they regenerate (`git diff HEAD...origin/main` on spec touches ui/contracts/conversions/migrations only), and `git merge-tree` is clean. Whichever of this PR and #29100 lands second merges main.
- Webhook `headers` (the same whole-map case) stays out of scope by the seat ruling on #29342; widening `type` to a union later is a widening.

## Verification

Readings on head `bb1718cc` (base `04e0c2c0`), all under `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0 each). Head `27e2a7a5` adds one commit that edits only the changeset's level and declaration line (no package source, no generated artifact), so these readings carry to it; the changeset gate was re-run on `27e2a7a5`.

<details><summary>Spec and consumer suites</summary>

- `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'`: 78/78 tasks, 0 cached.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 792 passed (792), Tests 23529 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 2 of 14 stale before `--fix` (`check:docs`, `check:strictness-ledger`), both regenerated and committed; `api-surface` not stale (no new export).
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `package-unmanaged-install.test.ts` + `protocol.duplicate-package-install-refusal.test.ts`: 2 files, 68 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client test`: 54 files, 693 tests passed; `typecheck` exit 0 (`PackageExportManifest` is the client's `packages.export` return type).
- `@objectstack/runtime` `packages-export-override-declaration`, `packages-export-per-package-layer`, `packages-seed-apply-read-decorations`, `packages-vetted-org-source`: 4 files, 114 tests passed.
- `@objectstack/cloud-connection` `marketplace-install-local-install-modes.test.ts`: 23 tests passed.
- Planner probe (temporary test file, deleted): before (rows removed, spec rebuilt, dist preflight `--absent` passed) `label` and `withheldMaps` each refused `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_UNCOPYABLE`; after, both accepted.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 103 families at `bb1718cc`; each ran with stdin closed, all 103 exit 0. Reconciliation: "103 derived, 103 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" (a DERIVED zero). Changed lines 161 (+144 / -17) against the 3000 threshold.

</details>
